## Create Task
This validates input and normalizes fields with slight errors from the user.

## Get Task(s)
 Get one task if id is provided. If not, get all tasks based on filter.

## Update Task
Update task based on the validity of fields provided.

## Delete Task 
Archive(soft-delete) task. Task is archived by updating status.

## Invalid Operation
Action does not match either read, create, update or delete.

## Info Endpoint
A mini doc that returns info on how to use each endpoint.
